انجذبوا (form VII)
# اِنْجَذَبُوا (injaḏabū) /in.d͡ʒa.ða.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# اِنْجَذِبُوا (injaḏibū) /in.d͡ʒa.ði.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
